subject: Model pin & phased cutover: runbook and comms timeline
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft runbook for pin + phased cutover (please review)

Team —

Putting this together ahead of next week's leadership sync. Goal: a short, prescriptive runbook for pinning customers to the current model (v3.4) and executing a phased cutover to v4.0-compatible routing variants. Key asks:

- Product: confirm which API routes must be pin-safe (generate, chat, embeddings) and whether we can surface a per-customer opt-out flag in the control plane by May 1.
- Sales/CS: confirm customers that require extra notice or legal review (I attached the current impact list).
- Legal/Security (cc'd Naomi): any compliance concerns with maintaining two serving variants concurrently?

Attached: runbook-v1.2.pdf (ops steps, rollback criteria), customer-impact-list.csv, and a set of templated comms.

Proposed high-level timeline:
- Apr 12: finalize pin API behavior and opt-out UX spec
- Apr 19: ship control-plane toggle + internal enablement
- Apr 26 — May 10: phased customer notifications and canary cutovers

Please annotate the runbook with explicit owners in the left margin (I started a draft). Short replies are fine — we need alignment by EOD Mon (Apr 12).

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Product, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
---
Attachments (stubs): runbook-v1.2.pdf (23 pages), customer-impact-list.csv (24 lines), cutover-email-templates.docx
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft runbook for pin + phased cutover (please review)

Laura —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes from infra/serving side:

- Pin behavior: we can support a per-customer pin at the routing layer; it will add ~3-5% CPU overhead on our shared pools during the overlap window. That is measurable but acceptable for a 2-week phased window.
- Opt-out UX: we can expose the toggle in the control plane; engineering estimate is 3 sprints (with a lightbackwards-compatible API shim). Targeting feature branch by Apr 19 is feasible if we lock the spec today.
- SLA/regression: recommend a canary cohort of 8 customers for week 1, then 30 customers for week 2 before wider cutover. We should preserve the per-token cost profile for pinned customers to avoid surprises.

I've attached a short CSV of customers I think are high-risk (same file, updated). Two asks for Sales/Product:
1) Confirm the 8 canary customers by Mon EOD (Aditya).
2) Product to sign off on rollback criteria — I added a 15% uplift in 95th latency as the trigger for immediate rollback.

I'll slot a 30-min ops readiness call on Apr 13 to walk the runbook steps and handoff.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
---
Attachments (stubs): customer-impact-list.csv (updated with risk column)
From: Rajiv Shah <rajiv.shah@acme-enterprises.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: legal-acme <legal@acme-enterprises.com>, integration@edgepartner.io
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft runbook for pin + phased cutover (please review)

Hi Priyom/Laura —

Thanks for the heads-up and for the draft runbook. A couple of concerns from Acme:

- We rely on stable embeddings for our search index. Any change that switches model variants without a migration window could regress search relevance.
- Our procurement team asks for a 60-day notice on any changes that may affect inference results; 2 weeks is shorter than our internal SLA.

We are open to being part of the canary cohort if Redwood can provide a scoped rollback guarantee and a temporary export of pre-cutover outputs for comparison. Can your team supply a delta export (aligned by request id) for the canary?

Also looping in legal to confirm if our change control requires signature on a change-order.

Best,
Rajiv Shah
Director of Product, Acme Enterprises
rajiv.shah@acme-enterprises.com
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Shah <rajiv.shah@acme-enterprises.com>, legal-acme <legal@acme-enterprises.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft runbook for pin + phased cutover (please review)

Closing the loop with a concrete, trimmed plan and owners based on feedback:

1) Canary cohort and exports
- Owners: Aditya (customer comms), Priyom (export pipeline), Laura (product acceptance)
- Action: Identify 10 canary customers (8 high-risk + 2 low-risk) by Apr 16. Aditya to confirm list and contact owners.
- Export: Priyom to enable delta export for canary requests (request-id mapping) and deliver daily diffs during week 1.

2) Timeline (compressed, with buffer)
- Apr 16: control-plane toggle is feature-complete and QAed
- Apr 19: enable toggle for canaries, start delta exports
- Apr 26: broaden to phased cohort (30 customers) if canary metrics pass
- May 10: complete cutover and deprecate v3.4 routing in hosted pools (customers pinned will remain on pinned variant until contract expiration)

3) Rollback criteria and SLAs
- Immediate rollback if latency 95th > +15% or if quality evals show >7% drop in embedding similarity for canary samples.
- For customers that request 60-day notice (like Acme), offer an 'extended notice' plan: we will keep them pinned for 60 days and supply exports and weekly syncs. Legal to review change-order template.

4) Comms
- Aditya to send tailored emails to canary customers by Apr 17 using the templates (attached).
- Public status page update scheduled Apr 19: short note + link to runbook and rollback policy.

If nobody objects, I'll mark this as approved for execution and Priyom, please proceed with the export pipeline and readiness call on Apr 13 record notes to the shared Drive.

Thanks — clear owners, clear criteria, limited exceptions for customers with contractual notice requirements.

Markus Klein
VP, Product Ops, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
---
Attachments referenced: cutover-email-templates.docx, runbook-v1.2.pdf
